# Graph-Level Metrics & Community Detection Comparison

**Sumber data:** v4_scoped (`nodes_v4_scoped.csv` + `edges_v4_scoped.csv`) — v4_hybrid dgn PERSON nasab-only di-scope keluar (co-participation network)
**Generated by:** `sna_graph_metrics.py`

## 1. Graph-Level Metrics

| Metric | Value | Interpretasi |
|---|---:|---|
| n_nodes | 137 | Jumlah Person (node) di graf |
| n_edges | 1853 | Jumlah relasi (co-participation + Person-Person) |
| average_degree | 27.05 | Rata-rata koneksi per orang |
| density | 0.1989 | Rasio actual edges vs possible edges (0=sparse, 1=complete graph) |
| average_clustering_coefficient | 0.7100 | Rata-rata seberapa cluster tetangga tiap node (lokal) |
| transitivity_global | 0.7957 | Global clustering: rasio segitiga / triplet (kohesi keseluruhan) |
| degree_assortativity | -0.0701 | Positif = high-degree connect to high-degree; negatif = high connect to low (hub-and-spoke) |
| n_components | 5 | Jumlah connected components (kalau >1, graf tidak fully connected) |
| giant_component_size | 128 | Ukuran komponen terbesar |
| giant_component_ratio | 0.9343 | % node dalam giant component |
| giant_diameter | 5 | Diameter giant component (jarak terjauh dua node) |
| giant_radius | 3 | Radius giant component |
| giant_avg_shortest_path | 1.96 | Rata-rata path length di giant component |

## 2. Community Detection Comparison

Bandingkan **3 metode community detection**:
- **Louvain (proper)** — `nx.community.louvain_communities()` (NetworkX 2.7+).
- **Greedy Modularity** — `nx.community.greedy_modularity_communities()` (yang dipakai `sna_analysis.py` existing, secara teknis BUKAN Louvain meskipun di kode lama dilabeli 'Louvain').
- **Girvan-Newman** — iterative edge removal, capped di 16 partisi.

### 2.1 Modularity & Jumlah Komunitas

| Method | n_communities | Modularity Q | Catatan |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| louvain | 8 | 0.2831 | Standar emas balanced quality+speed |
| greedy | 10 | 0.2607 | Faster tapi quality lebih rendah; legacy di `sna_analysis.py` |
| girvan_newman | 16 | 0.0301 | Slow tapi interpretable (edge-betweenness based) |

### 2.2 Pairwise Adjusted Rand Index (ARI)

ARI mengukur **kesepakatan** antara 2 partisi (0=random, 1=identical).
ARI tinggi → metode-metode menemukan struktur komunitas yang serupa.

| Method | louvain | greedy | girvan_newman |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| louvain | 1.0000 | 0.4737 | 0.1174 |
| greedy | 0.4737 | 1.0000 | 0.2237 |
| girvan_newman | 0.1174 | 0.2237 | 1.0000 |

### 2.3 Top members per community (louvain, top modularity)

Method pemenang berdasarkan modularity: **louvain** (Q=0.2831, 8 komunitas).

- **C1** (49 anggota): Abu Hurairah, Abu Musa, Abu Shafwan, Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah, Adam, Al-Baihaqi, Al-Harits bin Abdi, Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad (+41 lagi)
- **C2** (40 anggota): Abdullah bin Abbas, Abdullah bin Abu Bakar, Abdurrahman, Abdurrahman bin Auf, Abu Hudzaifah, Abu Jahal, Abu Lahab, Abu Lubabah bin Abdul (+32 lagi)
- **C3** (37 anggota): Abdullah bin Jahsy, Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salul, Abdullah bin Uraiqith, Abu Azzah, Abu Bakar, Abu Dujanah, Abu Salamah bin Abdul Asad, Abu Thalhah (+29 lagi)
- **C4** (3 anggota): Abdullah bin Atik, Abdullah bin Unais, Abu Rafi'
- **C5** (2 anggota): Kurz bin Jabir, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqash
- **C6** (2 anggota): Mirdas bin Nuhaik, Usamah bin Zaid
- **C7** (2 anggota): Nu'aim bin Ma'ud, Sulaith bin An- Nu'man
- **C8** (2 anggota): Abu Bashir, Abu Jandal

## 3. Klaim yang Bisa Dipertahankan (untuk Bab 4)

- Knowledge Graph Sirah ini punya **137 Person** dengan **1853 relasi** (density 0.1989).
- Struktur komunitas terdeteksi: **8 kelompok** (modularity 0.2831) — menunjukkan adanya **faksi/kelompok diskursus** yang berbeda.
- Clustering coefficient 0.7100 (lokal) vs 0.7957 (global) — interpretasi: banyak tetangga node yang juga saling terhubung (kohesi lokal tinggi).
- Degree assortativity -0.0701: mendekati neutral.

- ARI antara Louvain & Greedy: 0.4737 (agreement moderat — metode menghasilkan struktur yang berbeda, perlu pertimbangan saat klaim komunitas).
